determinism: verified (re-fill identical record_ids; merge stable-sorted by content-addressed id)
known_limitations: Targeted records are formulaic (carrier template 'Record for {name}, {label}: {target}, contact {email} [#ref]') — ~72% of the corpus is now enrichment; reduces template diversity. Tagged provenance.source_type='synthetic_lattice_enrichment' (filterable).
Domain distribution skews to 'general' (cells not pinning a domain default to general). Committed domain marginals + domain×adv_track cells are individually powered; overall balance is general-heavy.
Power is statistical precision on the SYNTHETIC distribution, NOT external validity (non-strippable DesignProvenance caveat; real-data correlation slice FR-027 / Pass-2).
